Container.Name: khinsider-sync
Container.Overview: Browse every soundtrack on downloads.khinsider.com in a web page, tick the albums or whole platforms you want, and keep them in sync. Pick MP3, FLAC or the best quality offered, album art included. Only new, incomplete or changed files are downloaded, parallel downloads tune themselves to what the server allows, and it can re-sync on a schedule.

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Where the albums go (pick a share). Each album gets a folder of its own below this folder.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Optional. When set, the browser asks for it (any user name).

Config.Name: FlareSolverr
Config.Description: Optional. A FlareSolverr server (e.g. http://YOUR-SERVER:8191) that gets pages past Cloudflare's browser check when one comes. Can also be set in Settings.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Used for file dates and the sync schedule.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User that owns downloaded files (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group that owns downloaded files (100 = users).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: 000 = files readable and writable by everyone on the share.
